name: Void Zombie

actions.name: Salt Water Vulnerability
actions.description: Salt water quickly attacks a larval akata's cells as a strong acid. If the void zombie is fully immersed in salt water, it takes @Damage[4d6[acid]] damage from the water immediately and at the end of each of its turns as long as it remains immersed. Its weakness to salt water applies to this damage. On any round in which the void zombie takes damage due to its salt water weakness, the larval akata withdraws to hide within the host's body and renders the void zombie @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

actions.name: Feed on Blood
actions.description:
Requirements The void zombie's previous action was a successful feeding tendril Strike against a living creature

Effect The void zombie drains blood from the required creature using its feeding tendril. The void zombie regains @Damage[4[healing]] Hit Points, and the creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} until it receives healing of any kind or amount.

notes: Strikes/defenses are a direct transcription of the real bestiary statblock (gamesystems/sf2e/packs/alien-core-bestiary) — see test/character-builder/extract-npc.test.mjs. Level 1 undead-brute pick (design doc §76 Phase 4, GH #64's own suggested-ten survey): Fist (unarmed) and Feeding Tendril (agile) both derive unmodified through the existing toCombatant. "Feed on Blood" is a real action, captured under `actions`, not mechanically wired (a real-HP-drain-and-heal ability this project's single-damage-type strike shape doesn't represent). "Salt Water Vulnerability"/"Void Healing" are real passives, likewise captured but not wired.
